create_get_nccl_mem_pool: create an NCCL symmetric memory pool using CUDAPluggableAllocator with ncclMemAlloc and ncclMemFree
build_symmetric_memory_context: build a context manager that allocates tensors in NCCL symmetric memory and registers them with ncclCommWindowRegister
test_is_tensor_in_symmetric_mempool: test whether a tensor's storage is allocated in the NCCL symmetric memory pool by checking data_ptr against pool segments
run_debug_check_symmetric_mempool: run a debug check that verifies tensors passed to communication ops are in the NCCL symmetric memory pool and logs warnings
review_use_symmetric_memory: review the use_symmetric_memory function that returns a SymmetricMemoryContext or nullcontext based on enable_symm_mem and world_size
